checks.name: E3-시장 분위기 정확성
checks.detail: questionable: The claim 'US equities still hit records on Aug 16' is inaccurate/misleading: Aug 16, 2026 was a Sunday with no trading. The actual last session (Fri Aug 14) saw the S&P 500 slip ~0.2% *away* from its record high (set Aug 12-13) after a weak University of Michigan consumer sentiment reading and a surprise drop in July retail sales — momentum was cooling, not extending to new records. The green/98.1 traffic light and 8 QQQ distribution-day count could not be independently verified, but the 'DANGER' distribution-day flag is at least directionally consistent with the Friday pullback and soft consumer data.

checks.name: E4-섹터 동향 정확성
checks.detail: questionable: AMZN/MSFT uptrend leadership and PLTR/VST downtrend laggard framing are plausible, but labeling PLTR a technical 'DOWNTREND' laggard is in tension with its actual recent action — PLTR is up ~30-35% over the past 30-90 days on a strong Q2 beat (EPS $0.41 vs $0.33 est., 93% revenue growth) and a new Mercury Systems defense deal; it is trading near/off recent highs, not broadly weak. Also, calling ANET's strength part of a rotation into 'energy' is a stretch — ANET's Aug 2026 rally is driven by AI/data-center networking demand (raised FY26 guidance to $12.6B, Barclays PT raised to $289) rather than an energy-sector story per se, though AI infra buildout does have power-demand linkages.

grok_report.summary: The core geopolitical item (China tariff-evasion report) is accurately sourced and still current. However, the market mood headline mischaracterizes Aug 16 as a day US equities 'hit records' when markets were closed that Sunday and the actual last session (Fri Aug 14) saw a pullback from records amid weak consumer sentiment and soft retail sales — this is a meaningful temporal/factual slip. Watchlist closing prices (TSM, NVDA, META, TSLA, PLTR, MU, CRWD) all check out accurately against real data, but PLTR's DOWNTREND/avoid tag conflicts with its strong recent earnings-driven rally, and the sector rotation narrative overstates an 'energy' rotation that is more accurately an AI-infrastructure story.
